lines.text: Imagine waking up one morning and discovering that every human on Earth has disappeared.
No people. No traffic. No voices.
Just you... and an entire planet.
At first, you search every house, every street and every hospital.
You find abandoned cars, unfinished meals and phones still ringing.
Millions of lives seem to have vanished in a single moment.
But strangely, every animal is still alive.
Days turn into weeks.
You move into a luxury hotel, explore abandoned cities and take whatever you need.
For the first time, there are no rules, no responsibilities and nobody to answer to.
But as the silence grows, even paradise begins to feel like a prison.
One night, you discover a television still working.
Every channel is broadcasting the same footage.
A live camera feed of your bedroom.
You watch yourself sleeping.
But the footage is coming from tomorrow.
Terrified, you rush back home.
You check every camera, every computer and every device.
Then you notice something impossible.
In tomorrow's footage, there are two people standing beside your bed.
One is you.
The other is watching you.
And suddenly, you realise... you were never the last human on Earth.
You were simply the last one who knew he wasn't alone.
